gloss: to ask again; to ask back

definitions.gloss: to ask again; to ask someone to repeat
definitions.explanation: To ask someone to say something again because you didn't hear or understand it the first time.
To respond to a question with another question, turning it back on the person who asked.

examples.japanese: よく{聞|き}こえなくて{聞|き}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I couldn't hear well, so I asked again.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}の{声|こえ}が{小|ちい}さくて、{何度|なんど}も{聞|き}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The voice on the phone was quiet, so I asked them to repeat several times.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{返|かえ}すのが{恥|は}ずかしくて、わかったふりをしてしまった。
examples.english: I was embarrassed to ask again, so I pretended I understood.

examples.japanese: 「どう{思|おも}う？」と{聞|き}かれて、「あなたは？」と{聞|き}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: When asked "What do you think?", I asked back "What about you?"

examples.japanese: {質問|しつもん}に{答|こた}えず、{逆|ぎゃく}に{聞|き}き{返|かえ}すのは{失礼|しつれい}だ。
examples.english: It's rude to not answer a question and instead ask one back.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}が{鋭|するど}い{質問|しつもん}をすると、{大臣|だいじん}は{笑|わら}いながら{聞|き}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: When the reporter asked a pointed question, the minister smiled and asked a question back.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), transitive. Compound of {聞|き}く + {返|かえ}す. The ～{返|かえ}す pattern means doing something back or again.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is much more common in daily life. Learners of Japanese will frequently need this word when they don't catch what someone said. Polite alternatives include もう{一度|いちど}お{願|ねが}いします.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何度|なんど}も{聞|き}き{返|かえ}す (to ask to repeat many times)
- {聞|き}き{返|かえ}す{勇気|ゆうき} (the courage to ask again)
